info.name: EasySpot API
info.description:
Postman collection for the EasySpot parking reservation backend (NestJS + TypeORM + MySQL + JWT).

Setup:
1. Start the API (npm run start:dev) and run npm run seed once.
2. Open the collection Variables tab and set seedPassword to the SEED_PASSWORD value from your .env.
3. Run the folders in order (or use the Collection Runner). Login requests save the JWT automatically.

variable.description: Set this to SEED_PASSWORD from your .env (not stored in the repo)
